create_DirectionalLights: create a DirectionalLights object with custom ambient, diffuse, and specular colors and light direction
create_PointLights: create a PointLights object with custom RGB colors and xyz light source location
create_AmbientLights: create an AmbientLights object with a custom ambient color for uniform scene lighting
run_diffuse: run the diffuse function to calculate Lambert cosine law light reflection on mesh normals
run_specular: run the specular function to calculate specular highlights given points, normals, camera position, and shininess
